title: Vioverse Stable Replacement — Unified Game
notes: The old layered interface was replaced by a complete self-contained HTML game entrypoint, eliminating dependence on extra JavaScript/CSS files. Preserves all 14 screens, gothic-purple UI, Characters and the interactive circular Forest Skill Tree, save data, idle gathering, branching expeditions, Forest Mastery upgrades and refunds, and five-second update checks. The correct GitHub-clone server launcher remains included.
